short_explanation: Treatment: randomized treatment assignment with cleaned-data arms: group_1_medication_1_communication_1; group_2_medication_1_communication_2; group_3_medication_2_communication_1; group_4_medication_2_communication_2. Publication-designated control/reference: group_1_medication_1_communication_1.
Primary outcome: General Assessment of Side Effects (GASE) bodily-sickness symptom score, measured at 6 hours.
Primary outcome: Change from baseline to 6 hours in gase. Publication-defined endpoint context: Bodily sickness symptoms and affective symptoms through 6 hours.
Primary outcome: State-Trait Anxiety-Depression Inventory (STADI) state global score, measured at 6 hours.
Primary outcome: Change from baseline to 6 hours in stadi global. Publication-defined endpoint context: Bodily sickness symptoms and affective symptoms through 6 hours.

Secondary outcome: Multidimensional Mood Questionnaire (MDBF) positive-mood score, measured at 6 hours.
Secondary outcome: Tnfa peak increase, measured at 3 hours.

Secondary outcome: Cortisol peak increase, measured at 3 hours.
